title: GLG Receives "Equality 100 Award" in 2026 Corporate Equality Index
summary: GLG received the Human Rights Campaign Foundation's Equality 100 Award in the 2026 Corporate Equality Index, recognizing it as a leader in LGBTQ+ workplace inclusion. GLG was among 534 companies earning a score of 100 in the 2026 CEI.
whyItMatters: A workplace inclusion signal rather than core product news, but relevant for buyers tracking corporate governance and culture across expert network providers.
